answer: Behavioral Provenance Tracking. Each identity accrues a verifiable pattern of transaction timing, counterparties, and resource usage, hashed into a rolling profile like a quill recording a ledger. Detection flags clusters whose profiles correlate too tightly under a gale of noise injected into timing metadata. A sybil swarm must mimic diverse independent histories, so each fake identity pays a real cost in fabricated activity and sustained divergence maintenance. A raven-like auditor later reviews flagged clusters for confirmation.
